input.question: Who is the main character in the video game "Who Framed Roger Rabbit"?

documents.text: Who Framed Roger Rabbit (1989 video game) Who Framed Roger Rabbit is an action-adventure video game created for the Nintendo Entertainment System by Rare and published by LJN in 1989. The single-player game is loosely based on the film of the same name and had combined elements of graphic adventure computer games with some more traditional action adventure gameplay. A different version of the game was also released for various computer systems in 1988. The game takes place in Los Angeles in 1947.
